text: Binary per-row check on other users' comments (OC_comments, a JSON list; title and argument give the OP's view and are context only for identifying the OP's initial premise). Returns 1 if at least one single comment first explicitly concedes that the OP's initial premise (a starting claim of the view) is valid, correct or reasonable, and then, within that same comment, introduces disagreement, divergence or a counter-argument; the two parts cannot be split across comments. Vague politeness, mere topical engagement, or acknowledging only that the OP has feelings or made an effort, without conceding the premise's validity, does not count. Returns 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies, including an empty list. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing so the premise can't be identified. Ignores OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks or resolution updates, and any text reporting the outcome, even in the argument, and doesn't use them as evidence. Generic delta or platform-rule discussion may be kept. Uses the current text only, with no initial snapshot inferred, and list order is not chronology.
